answer: Sybil resistance via bonded jury quorums: jurors are drawn by commit-reveal lottery seeded from prior block hashes, so shills cannot pre-position. Each juror escrows reputation-coin before signing a verdict. Verdicts are cross-checked; repeat dissenters get escrow slashed, identity weight decays to zero. To sway one decision an attacker must forge many identities, win a lottery per identity, and bond coin on all - cost grows superlinearly with attack size. Like voters crossing to an island on a marble bridge while a raven audits every crossing: honest jurors risk only honest disagreement.
